final: WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT maj.department, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as cnt FROM income i INNER JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id GROUP BY maj.department), dept_shares AS (SELECT department, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM dept_counts) as share FROM dept_counts), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM dept_shares), filtered_depts AS (SELECT ds.department, ds.cnt, ds.share FROM dept_shares ds, avg_calc WHERE ds.share > avg_calc.avg_share) SELECT SUM(fd.cnt) as sum_counts, AVG(fd.share) as avg_shares, AVG(fd.share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_calc)) as avg_diff FROM filtered_depts fd
